description: This file defines a factory class 'ServerRequestCreatorFactory' responsible for creating and determining the server request creator object in the Slim Framework. It manages the instantiation and decoration of server request creators based on available implementations and configuration.

classes.name: ServerRequestCreatorFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and determining the appropriate server request creator instance, supporting decoration and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the server request creator instance.

methods.name: determineServerRequestCreator
methods.description: Determines and returns a suitable server request creator, throwing an exception if none are available.

methods.name: attemptServerRequestCreatorDecoration
methods.description: Wraps the server request creator with decorators if enabled and available.

methods.name: setPsr17FactoryProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider to supply PSR-17 factories.

methods.name: setServerRequestCreator
methods.description: Sets a specific server request creator instance.

methods.name: setSlimHttpDecoratorsAutomaticDetection
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic detection of HTTP decorators.
